purpose: Observe CryptAcquireContextW(PROV_RSA_FULL, CRYPT_VERIFYCONTEXT | CRYPT_SILENT), CryptGenRandom and CryptReleaseContext first in a fresh native process under the original restricted primary token. Existing CNG observations follow. No entropy leaves the child or is supplied to Node.
limits: Version 2 uses a fixed 64-byte status/boolean packet; old, malformed or incomplete cleanup reports refuse.
Legacy CryptoAPI executes first. The later BCrypt calls are no longer claimed as first crypto calls in this new child; historical cold-CNG evidence remains source-specific.
The same original primary token, private desktop, environment, owned pipes, Job, deadlines and Node acceptance checks remain.
This is a CI-only observation of the upstream legacy API parameters, not an RNG fallback, persisted key-container operation or startup repair.
